nav.label: Admin sections
nav.logoLabel: Mapa Papin, go to the map

login.title: Mapa Papin · Admin
login.hint: Only for the people behind the map.
login.denied: We could not confirm who you are. Sign in with your email and we will send you a one-time code.
login.offline: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
login.note: Protected by Cloudflare Access · one-time code

notFound.title: This section peeled off
notFound.body: Pick one from the menu or go back to the review queue.

duplicate_photo_far_apart.label: Duplicate photo far away
duplicate_photo_far_apart.help: The same photo is uploaded somewhere else, far from here. Is it the same sticker or was it uploaded twice? Keep the one that matches the real place and hide the other.

exif_gps_mismatch.label: Photo GPS does not match
exif_gps_mismatch.help: The GPS in the photo is far from the pin. If the photo is right, use “Use the photo GPS”; if the pin is right, approve it as it is.

reported.label: Reported
reported.help: Someone reported this sticker. Look at the photo and the place, then decide whether it stays, gets hidden or gets deleted.

legacy_other_no_data.label: No photo
legacy_other_no_data.help: It comes from the old survey: an “Other” with no photo or details. If there is no way to tell what it is, hide it.

keys.label: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.body: They work in the review queue, except while you are typing in a field.

review.title: Review queue
review.pickOne: Pick a sticker from the list.
review.emptyBody: Everything odd has already been through here. Go have a mate.
review.emptyFilteredBody: No sticker in the queue matches those filters.
review.openPhoto: Open the photo of the {type} sticker full size
review.needOneType: Pick at least one sticker type.
review.coordsHint: Drag the pin or type latitude and longitude.
review.coordsError: Type latitude and longitude, for example -34.9061, -56.1993.
review.batch: This sticker came from a batch (…{id}).

assign.title: Assign person
assign.body: Choose who uploaded and stuck {n} stickers. This replaces whoever was assigned.
assign.label: Person
assign.hint: If the name does not exist, the person is created.

delete.title: Delete this sticker?
delete.body: It goes to the Trash. It is not really deleted: you can restore it from Stickers.

batch.title: Hide the whole batch?
batch.body: Every sticker that was uploaded together gets hidden. You can show them again one by one from Stickers.

gps.noOriginal: This sticker has no original photo saved.
gps.used: Pin moved to the photo location.
gps.error: We could not read the photo. Try again.

map.dragHint: Drag the pin to fix it
map.error: The map could not load. You can fix it with the coordinates below.

toast.batchHidden: {n} stickers of the batch were hidden
toast.moved: Pin moved. The place name updates on its own.

export.label: Export
export.hint: All three formats follow the filters below. The GeoPackage opens in QGIS.

types.title: Sticker types
types.intro: The order is the one of the chips and the legend. Changes show on the map right away, no deploy.
types.replaceIcon: Drop a new icon, or keep this one
types.dropHint: PNG or WebP with a transparent background, up to 600 KB
types.label: Name
types.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. It cannot be changed later.
types.allowsTextHint: Like “Other”: whoever adds it writes what it is.
types.activeHint: When off, it does not show up when adding stickers.
types.preview: How it looks on the map
types.previewEmpty: Pick an icon to see it.
types.errLabel: Write a name for the type.
types.errSlug: The code must be lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
types.errOrder: The order is a number from 0 to 999.
types.promoteIntro: These are the texts people typed under “Other”. If one repeats, turn it into its own type and the stickers move over by themselves.
types.promoteNone: There is no free text under “Other” yet.
types.promoted: {label} is now a type: {n} stickers moved to it

people.title: People
people.intro: Pick two or more to merge them. People are never merged on their own: you decide.
people.pickTwo: Pick at least two people to merge.
people.mergeBody: Choose the name that stays. The stickers of {names} move to that name, both as “stuck by” and as “added by” ({n} in total). This cannot be undone.
people.renameHint: The old name stays as an alias, so nothing is lost.
people.errExists: Someone is already called {name}. If it is the same person, merge them.
people.errInstagramExists: That Instagram belongs to someone else.
people.instagramHint: Only an admin can change it: people set it once.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modeOpenHint: It shows up right away. Turnstile + reports + review.
settings.modeApprovalHint: Nothing shows until an admin approves it.
settings.storageHint: Photos and originals in R2 ({pct} % used). Warning at 7 GB and alert at 9 GB.
settings.storageWarning: You are past 7 GB. Download a backup and move the originals to Drive before it fills up.
settings.storageCritical: Less than 1 GB left. Move the originals to Drive now, or photo uploads will stop.
settings.backupHint: Data every night at 04:00 (UYT) and photos every Sunday. 30 daily and 12 weekly are kept.
settings.langHint: For new visitors. Everyone can change it from the menu.
settings.featuresHint: Off · admins only · everyone. They turn on without a deploy.
settings.mapHint: A MapLibre style.json. If you swap it for a broken one, the map stops loading.
settings.mapError: Paste a full URL that starts with https://.
settings.auditHint: Everything changed from the admin is written down.

error.unauthorized: Your session expired. Reload the page to sign in again.
error.generic: It could not be saved. Try again.
error.invalid: Some value is not valid. Check it and try again.
error.notFound: That sticker is gone. Reload the list.
error.slugExists: There is already a type with that code. Pick another.
error.iconRequired: Upload a PNG or WebP icon for the type.
error.badIcon: The icon must be a PNG or WebP of up to 600 KB.
error.unknownType: That type does not exist. Reload the page.
error.selfRequiresReporter: This sticker has no uploader, so it cannot be “Me”.
error.noBackup: There is no backup to download yet.
